name: KALLAX TV storage combination 147x60, white
description: 147 x 39 x 59.6 cm (W x D x H), 4 cubes + low top row. Lower row: 4 KALLAX cubes that take inserts/boxes; top row: 4 low open compartments (layout of the top row inferred, IKEA only lists the outer size and "large/small shelves"). Open back. With 2x insert with door + 2x insert with 2 drawers. IKEA does not say which cells hold the inserts: positions are assumed, change the `inserts` param to match yours.
